verdict.rationale: The evidence shows versioned npm packages (playcanvas 2.22.2, editor-mcp-server 0.7.1) and a documented Editor API. Nothing describes API versioning guarantees, a stability contract, or a documented deprecation policy. A package version number alone is adjacent evidence and does not meet the story's core requirement of a documented deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
